title: Baidu's AI Cloud grew 94% and iQIYI's average target still implies112% — today's China and EM earnings and targets
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
A batch of China and emerging-market names reported today (or are  
about to), and several came with fresh price-target write-ups. The  
prints are mixed — some real beats, some messy — and one of the  
flashier targets looks stale.  
  
Here is the scorecard from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Baidu (BIDU)\*\* — Baidu's AI Cloud infrastructure climbed 94%, per  
today's write-up, even as total revenue came in at RMB30.8 billion  
($4.60 billion), down 1% year over year. Non-GAAP diluted EPS of  
RMB6.78 ($1.01) beat consensus.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/baidu-bidu-q3-results-ai-cloud-infrastructure-climbs-94-as-transition-continues-39313/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/baidu-bidu-q3-results-ai-cloud-infrastructure-climbs-94-as-transition-continues-39313/)  
  
\*\*2. Baidu (BIDU)\*\* — The $130 central target is the average of  
roughly 30 verified analyst targets (about $132), rounded to a clean  
figure. With BIDU near $74, reaching $130 would take a gain of about  
75%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/baidu-bidu-can-the-stock-deliver-a-75-move-to-the-130-analyst-target-39317/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/baidu-bidu-can-the-stock-deliver-a-75-move-to-the-130-analyst-target-39317/)  
  
\*\*3. XPeng (XPEV)\*\* — Third-quarter revenue rose 19.1% to RMB24.28  
billion ($3.62 billion), beating consensus by about $130 million.  
Deliveries reached 118,390 units, up 15% quarter over quarter.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/xpeng-xpev-q3-results-show-19-1-revenue-growth-amid-narrowing-losses-39320/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/xpeng-xpev-q3-results-show-19-1-revenue-growth-amid-narrowing-losses-39320/)  
  
\*\*4. XPeng (XPEV)\*\* — The $17 central target is the average of nine  
verified analyst targets, ranging from $10 to $28. With XPEV near  
$9.67, reaching $17 would take a gain of about 76%. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/xpeng-xpev-analyst-price-target-of-17-implies-76-upside-39324/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/xpeng-xpev-analyst-price-target-of-17-implies-76-upside-39324/)  
  
\*\*5. XP\*\* — Net revenue was R$5.14 billion, up 9% and slightly above  
the R$5.1 billion consensus. Adjusted diluted EPS was R$2.69, up 9%  
but below the R$2.78 estimate — a revenue beat and an EPS miss.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/xp-inc-xp-reports-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-9-with-strong-shareholder-returns-39328/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/xp-inc-xp-reports-q3-2026-earnings-revenue-9-with-strong-shareholder-returns-39328/)  
  
\*\*6. XP\*\* — The $25 target is the rounded average of nine verified  
analyst targets, spanning about $15 to $38, not an official published  
consensus. With shares near $14.73, reaching $25 would take a gain of  
about 70%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/xp-inc-xp-analyst-targets-average-25-with-70-upside-potential-39327/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/xp-inc-xp-analyst-targets-average-25-with-70-upside-potential-39327/)  
  
\*\*7. KE (BEKE)\*\* — Net revenues were RMB20.99 billion (about $3.13  
billion), down 8.9% year over year. Non-GAAP net income surged 102.6%  
to RMB2.605 billion, with the non-GAAP margin up 12.4 points to 6.8%.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/ke-holdings-beke-delivers-sharp-profit-growth-in-q3-2026-even-as-revenue-declines-39311/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/ke-holdings-beke-delivers-sharp-profit-growth-in-q3-2026-even-as-revenue-declines-39311/)  
  
\*\*8. KE (BEKE)\*\* — The $24 central target is the average of six  
verified analyst targets, rounded from about $23.90. From about  
$18.65, that implies a move of about 29%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/ke-holdings-beke-can-the-stock-deliver-a-29-move-to-24-39316/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/ke-holdings-beke-can-the-stock-deliver-a-29-move-to-24-39316/)  
  
\*\*9. H World Group (HTHT)\*\* — The write-up frames this as a Q3 beat  
with a full-year guidance raise. Revenue was RMB7.75 billion, up  
11.3%, net income rose 22.6% to RMB1.80 billion, and adjusted net  
income climbed 31.5% to RMB2.00 billion.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/h-world-group-htht-delivers-q3-earnings-beat-and-raises-full-year-guidance-39312/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/h-world-group-htht-delivers-q3-earnings-beat-and-raises-full-year-guidance-39312/)  
  
\*\*10. H World (HTHT)\*\* — The $62 central target is the average of  
eight verified analyst targets, ranging from about $57 to $68. HTHT  
last closed near $54.88, so reaching $62 would take a move of about  
13%. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/h-world-group-limited-htht-path-to-the-62-target-offers-13-upside-potential-39315/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/h-world-group-limited-htht-path-to-the-62-target-offers-13-upside-potential-39315/)  
  
\*\*11. iQIYI (IQ)\*\* — The $1.44 central target is the average of five  
verified analyst targets published between April and August 2026 — so  
those figures may be stale after the post-earnings selloff. IQ traded  
near $0.68, implying about 112% upside to $1.44. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/iqiyi-iq-analyst-price-targets-signal-112-upside-potential-39347/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/iqiyi-iq-analyst-price-targets-signal-112-upside-potential-39347/)  
  
\*\*12. PagSeguro Digital (PAGS)\*\* — Adjusted EPS of $0.43 beat the  
$0.41 consensus. Revenue of about $989.7 million came in just under  
the $996.2 million estimate, with loan growth of 25% in the write-up's  
headline.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/pagseguro-digital-pags-delivers-eps-beat-with-25-loan-growth-in-q3-39333/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/pagseguro-digital-pags-delivers-eps-beat-with-25-loan-growth-in-q3-39333/)  
  
\*\*13. Trip.com Group (TCOM)\*\* — Trip.com is expected to report Q3 in  
late November, after the U.S. close. Consensus is about $1.18 in  
adjusted earnings per ADS on revenue near $2.82 billion, though  
estimates vary.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/trip-com-group-tcom-q3-2026-earnings-key-expectations-for-the-travel-platform-39314/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/trip-com-group-tcom-q3-2026-earnings-key-expectations-for-the-travel-platform-39314/)  
  
\*\*14. Niu Technologies (NIU)\*\* — Revenue was RMB1,713.6 million, up  
1.2%, but the company swung to a net loss of RMB34.0 million from net  
income of RMB81.7 million a year earlier. E-scooter volume rose 15.4%  
to 537,457 units, with international sales up 226.3%.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/niu-technologies-niu-q3-results-show-international-growth-amid-profit-squeeze-39392/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/niu-technologies-niu-q3-results-show-international-growth-amid-profit-squeeze-39392/)  
  
Which of these China or EM prints looks like the cleanest beat, and  
which target are you most skeptical of — especially iQIYI's  
April–August average?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 16) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
